Report rows that should be encrypted at rest but are stored in plaintext.

## Usage

```console
coder server dbcrypt audit [flags]
```

## Description

```console
Scans every dbcrypt-managed column for non-empty values with a NULL key ID, which means the value is stored in plaintext. This catches rows written by code paths that bypass encryption as well as rows that predate enabling it. The command performs reads only, requires no encryption keys, and exits with a non-zero status when any plaintext row is found. Run `coder server dbcrypt rotate` to encrypt the reported rows.
```
